# Proof of Making — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-107061
Voiceover: A documented copy after a Worth model makes the line between reference, attribution, and surviving object evidence visible.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of Miss Agnes Miles Carpenter, 1941

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CO09-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · ORIGIN — What is the earliest reliable record?. Preserve native file, physical notebook or sample, creator, date basis, device or system context, identifier, and custody. Distinguish recorded time from an unverified recollection.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO09-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · CHANGE — Can development be reconstructed?. Link versions, annotations, patterns, fittings, samples, approvals, and rejected alternatives. Keep contributor corrections and disagreements rather than overwriting them.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO09-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · RIGHT — What does the evidence not decide?. Separate factual creation history from U.S. copyright authorship, work-made-for-hire, transfer, contract, patent, design, trademark, foreign-law, and confidentiality questions.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO09-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · CUSTODY — Can the chain survive movement?. Record every deposit, handoff, copy, migration, sale, loan, publication, return, and deletion with responsible person and integrity check.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
